name: Tallow alcohol
description: Tallow alcohol (CAS 99561-04-3 ), also supplied under the trade designation HD-Talgocenol 50-55, is a fatty alcohol mixture derived from animal tallow by reduction of the corresponding fatty acids. It functions primarily as an emulsifier, lubricant, and surface modifier across personal care, industrial, and textile processing applications. In personal care formulations, it acts as an emulsion stabilizer. It is used in creams, lotions, and hair conditioners, contributing to texture and product consistency. Textile and leather processors use it as a fiber lubricant and softening agent during wet processing. This improves handle and reduces friction-related damage. In metalworking fluids and industrial lubricants, it serves as a base component or additive that enhances film formation on metal surfaces. Rubber and tire compounders incorporate it as a processing aid to improve dispersion of fillers. This helps to reduce compound viscosity during mixing and improves overall manufacturing efficiency. Tallow alcohol is typically supplied as a solid waxy material in flake or pastille form for ease of handling. This allows for precise dosing in various industrial and chemical processes. Standard grades include technical and cosmetic-grade specifications. Purity and carbon chain distribution, predominantly C16–C18, are key quality parameters buyers evaluate during the procurement process. Packaging is available in bags or drums, with bulk options for high-volume industrial procurement. This ensures flexible logistics solutions for manufacturers across different sectors and regions.
